welcome.title: Welcome to SEDES
welcome.description: In less than a minute we'll show you the essentials for tracking drought and desertification in Brazil.

items.monitoring: See the products on the map.
items.analysis: Combine several indices in a multicriteria analysis.

spatialScope.title: Choose where to look
spatialScope.description: Choose the map area: the whole country, a region, a state, a biome, the Semi-arid region or ASD and surroundings. The active product is shown only inside it.

layerCard.title: Each card is a product
layerCard.description: Use the on/off toggle on the left to show the product on the map; the legend appears in the bottom right corner. The “i” explains what the product measures, and Details opens charts, the ranking and the search by state or municipality.

mapSettings.title: Map settings
mapSettings.description: Switch the basemap between Satellite and Street. With a product on, you can also adjust its opacity.

territories.title: Territories
territories.description: Show Indigenous Lands, Quilombola Territories, Settlements and Conservation Units on the map, or search for a territory by name.

replay.title: All set
replay.description: To see this walkthrough again, just click Tour.

replayInMore.title: All set
replayInMore.description: To see this walkthrough again, tap More and then Tour.

intro.title: Prioritization
intro.description: Combine indicators to find out which municipalities need attention first.

criteria.title: Choose the indicators
criteria.description: In Add or edit indicators, pick up to eight and give each one a weight. The bar shows how much each indicator weighs in the analysis, and the “i” explains what it measures.

area.title: Set the analysis area
area.description: Choose where to compare municipalities: the whole country, a region, a state, a biome, the Semiarid region or ASD and Surroundings.

level.title: Ranking granularity
level.description: Choose whether municipalities are compared all together or within each state, region or biome.

submit.title: Analyze
submit.description: Click Analyze to see municipalities classified by priority level on the map. Then download the map, the spreadsheet or the report.

intro.title: Communication
intro.description: Generate a ready-to-share report with maps, charts and notes about the territory you choose.

area.title: Choose the territory
area.description: Search for a municipality or choose a larger area: a state, a region, a biome, the Semiarid region or ASD and Surroundings.

layers.title: Choose the products
layers.description: Check the monitoring products that go into the report. Those without data for the chosen territory are disabled.

submit.title: Generate the report
submit.description: Click Generate report to see the preview alongside, where you can download the PDF.
